cards.title: Head and body
cards.body: A full page starts with `<!DOCTYPE html>`, then `<html>` holding a `<head>` (facts about the page) and a `<body>` (what you see).

hi.title: Head aur body
hi.body: Poora page `<!DOCTYPE html>` se shuru hota hai, phir `<html>` jismein ek `<head>` (page ke baare mein jaankari) aur ek `<body>` (jo aap dekhte ho) hote hain.

cards.title: The title
cards.body: `<title>` goes in the `<head>`. It doesn't show on the page: it is the name on the browser tab and in search results.

hi.title: Title
hi.body: `<title>` `<head>` mein jaata hai. Yeh page par nahi dikhta: yeh browser tab aur search results mein dikhne wala naam hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The browser tab does not show `My recipes`. Tap the line in the wrong place.

bug.fix: `<title>` belongs in the `<head>`, not the `<body>`. Move it between `<head>` and `</head>`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Browser tab `My recipes` nahi dikhata. Galat jagah wali line par tap karo.
hi.fix: `<title>` `<head>` mein aata hai, `<body>` mein nahi. Use `<head>` aur `</head>` ke beech le jao.

check.question: Where does `<title>` go?
check.explanation: The title is information about the page, so it goes in the `<head>`.

hi.question: `<title>` kahan jaata hai?
hi.explanation: Title page ke baare mein jaankari hai, isliye woh `<head>` mein jaata hai.

exercise.prompt: Write a full page: a `<head>` with the title `My Page`, and a `<body>` with an `<h1>`.
exercise.promptHi: Poora page likho: ek `<head>` jismein title `My Page` ho, aur ek `<body>` jismein ek `<h1>` ho.
exercise.starterCode:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <!-- add a head with a title, and a body with an h1 -->
</html>

checks.label: The `<head>` has a `<title>` that says `My Page`
checks.labelHi: `<head>` mein ek `<title>` hai jismein `My Page` likha hai
